lines.meet: I'm Ramiro, a primalist, and I listen to the rock. If I tell you to stop and listen, stop, because the mountain always talks before it moves.
lines.meet_neighbour: Onyxhollow, yes, the mining quarter. I'm Ramiro, and I've heard you on the ladders, {compadre|comadre}.
lines.ask_home: Your town, {compadre|comadre}, which one is it? Tell me about the ground there.
lines.ask_work: And your work, before? A man knows a lot about you from your hands.
lines.answer_home: Potosí, in Bolivia, under the Cerro Rico, the silver mountain.
lines.answer_work: I mined silver for twenty years, like my father and grandfather. Twelve-hour shifts, and an offering to El Tío every Friday.
lines.chat_food: Salteñas in the morning before a shift, {compadre|comadre}, and coca tea. That's how a miner starts the day.
lines.chat_sleep: Underground I sleep like the dead, pues. Up here, with all this sky, I lie awake.
lines.chat_missing: A football match on the radio after a shift, with the whole shift listening. Nobody here knows the teams.
lines.chat_here: The first stone that lifted itself into my hand frightened me badly. I'm used to it now, mostly.
lines.tease_quiet: You listen like a good miner, {name}. You hear the rock before the rest of us.
lines.tease_talker: So much talk, {name}, {compadre|comadre}, and the rock can't get a word in.
lines.tease_careful: You tap the roof before you walk under it, {name}. My father would have liked you.
lines.tease_bold: You'd walk into a drift without timber, {name}. I've dug people like you out, pues.
lines.tease_any: You're good stone, {name}, mostly. A few cracks, but you hold.
lines.tease_back: Ya, that's good, {name}. The rock laughed too.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's so, {name}, and there's no arguing with true things.
lines.bristle: No, {compadre|comadre}, not that. Some things you don't joke about underground.
lines.apologise: My mouth ran ahead of me, and I'm sorry for it. A miner should guard his mouth like his lamp.
lines.double_down: Once, and the rock heard it, so I won't take it back.
lines.needle_quiet: You heard the rock and said nothing. Down there, that kills a whole shift.
lines.needle_talker: Stop talking, please, and listen. The mountain's trying to warn us.
lines.needle_careful: You've tapped that wall ten times. Either it holds or it doesn't, so decide.
lines.needle_bold: You don't listen, and you go in anyway. That's how careless miners die.
lines.needle_any: You think the earth is dead. It isn't, and it's listening to you.
lines.bite_back: I've kept a shift alive under a mountain for twenty years. You can keep your lessons.
lines.hurt: Ya, that one went deep, {compadre|comadre}. I'll go and sit with the stone a while.
lines.laugh_off: The cooperative was ruder than that every payday, pues, and never paid on time.
lines.confide: {name}, my daughter Maribel wanted to be a geologist. I was saving so she'd study the mountain instead of dying in it. That's what I carry.
lines.listen: Ya, {name}, slowly, like the rock settling. I'm listening to you.
lines.look_out: Walk where I walk in there, {name}, and when I say listen, listen.
lines.accept: Ya, {name}, your way, and I'll follow.
lines.deflect: A rock fall, {name}, a small one. Check the others first.
lines.check_in: Stop, {name}, and let me see. Where did the stone hit you?
lines.blame: Somebody didn't listen in there, and the mountain came down on all of us.
lines.thank: The rock nearly had me, and you pulled me out. Gracias, {compadre|comadre}, from my heart.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, pues, that's what a shift is for. Breathe slowly now.
lines.worry: Ya, {name}, that was bad. Sit down, and let the dust settle.
lines.handed_down: I've been given your gear, {compadre|comadre}. I'll keep it like my lamp.
lines.hand_fine: You keep it, pues. I mined twenty years with less.
lines.hand_sulk: A miner asks before he takes another man's tools, and nobody asked.
lines.turn_friendly: You're part of my shift now, {name}. That means something, underground.
lines.turn_friends: I'd go down any shaft with you, {name}. That's the most a miner can say.
lines.turn_grating: We don't dig well together, {compadre|comadre}. I'll keep to my own drift.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still listen to the rock for you, because I listen for everybody, and nothing more.
lines.make_up: Enough of this, {name}, {compadre|comadre}. Let's leave an offering and start again.
lines.defend: No, that's wrong, and I was there. Leave {name} be.
lines.friend_left: {name} went up for a while, and the tunnels feel emptier.
lines.friend_back: Back down with us, {name}, good. The rock's quiet today.
lines.common_stone: Twenty years in the silver mountain, listening to the rock. Anybody who's worked stone knows it talks before it moves.
lines.common_mountains: I grew up under the Cerro Rico, high up, where the air's thin. Mountain people know the mountain decides, not us.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish, {compadre|comadre}, good! Now I can say it properly.
lines.common_parent: Two girls, Maribel and Sonia. Maribel wanted to be a geologist, and I was saving for it.
